name: SeedLegals
description: SeedLegals provides company formation, cap tables, equity, funding, legal documents, signatures, compliance workflows, and startup administration.
agentUseSummary: SeedLegals cannot currently be connected as an autonomous Relay provider. Its official hosted MCP connector requires an existing user to complete interactive sign-in, deliberately does not support headless use, and exposes sensitive cap-table and legal-document reads alongside document sharing, signature reminders, and agreement creation. Relay will not reuse browser sessions, capture tokens, infer unpublished tool schemas, or mount broad legal and equity authority without a supported service credential and bounded distributable contract.

blocked.label: Connect SeedLegals headlessly
blocked.description: SeedLegals requires interactive user sign-in and explicitly says its hosted MCP connector is not designed for fully automated or headless workflows.

blocked.label: Access company or legal data
blocked.description: Companies, shareholders, ownership percentages, share classes, option pools, documents, signatories, deadlines, events, and other confidential legal or equity data are blocked without a supported bounded authorization contract.

blocked.label: Perform consequential legal actions
blocked.description: Document sharing, signature reminders, quick-agreement creation, emails, feedback recording, and all other writes are blocked; the provider documents confirmation and explicit opt-in requirements.

blocked.label: Use unsupported automation
blocked.description: Relay will not reuse browser sessions, capture OAuth credentials, scrape the dashboard, reverse-engineer private endpoints or unpublished MCP schemas, pass through raw MCP tools, or impersonate interactive consent.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No autonomous agent action can be enabled without a supported headless authorization contract, stable bounded tool schemas, and enforceable separation of reads from consequential legal actions.

runtimeSupport.description: SeedLegals' interactive user MCP connection is intentionally not headless and cannot be mounted as autonomous OpenClaw tools under a supported service contract.
SeedLegals' interactive user MCP connection is intentionally not headless and cannot be mounted as autonomous Hermes tools under a supported service contract.

providerSetup.blocker: SeedLegals' official hosted MCP endpoint authenticates only through an interactive existing-account sign-in, provides no API key or documented service credential, explicitly says it is not designed for fully automated or headless use, and exposes confidential cap-table/legal data plus document sharing, signature reminders, and agreement creation. The public guide describes use cases but does not publish stable exact tool and input schemas that Relay can safely pin and test.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not expose Connect, request account credentials, capture OAuth tokens, reuse a browser session, publish runtime tools, or automate the SeedLegals dashboard. Reconsider only if SeedLegals publishes a supported headless or service authorization contract with stable versioned tool schemas, least-privilege read scopes, revocation, audit semantics, and enforceable separation of sensitive reads from legal/document actions.

evidence.supports: SeedLegals documents its hosted MCP endpoint, interactive existing-account sign-in, lack of an API key, account-permission inheritance, confidential cap-table and document reads, document sharing, signature reminders, agreement creation, and an explicit statement that the connector is not designed for fully automated or headless workflows.

SeedLegals identifies company, legal, financial, employee, investor, cap-table, document, and user data as sensitive or confidential, assigns customers responsibility for permissions and account activity, and requires explicit permission for data access. Relay therefore will not infer autonomous authority from an interactive user session.
